subject: Sherpa guide: MAP slippage containment + rollback plan
messages:
From: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@helios-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP update — close date risk

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side — internal testing uncovered a performance integration gap that pushes our acceptance window by roughly three business weeks. We know the MAP had us at Aug 1 go-live; that now looks unlikely without a short remediation phase.

Can you send an updated MAP that: 
- calls out the conditional rollback milestones we discussed in the demo (prefix caching, model variant fallback),
- shows a compact remediation timeline we can share with Procurement,
- lists any SLA exception asks so I can loop Legal?

Tom and I want to avoid a full contract rework; a concise containment plan will help.

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor Shaw
Head of Product Integrations
Helios Systems
[Attachment: error-log-tail.txt (txt)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: MAP update — close date risk

Eleanor — thanks for the flag. We ran a quick triage and have a proposed containment path. High level:

1) Short-term rollback guard (72h window): enable the tracked model-variant + prefix cache reset.
2) Mid-term fix (2 weeks): prioritize the eval set failing in your environment and apply conservative quantization profile.
3) Acceptance extension: propose 10 business days from our final cut to allow smoke and load testing.

I'm attaching a compact MAP draft (MAP_v2.xlsx) and a checklist for the rollback steps. The MAP includes explicit success criteria per evaluation gate so Procurement/Legal can see what we would sign off on without changing economic terms.

Two asks from us: 
- Can Helios confirm the internal QA window (how many days you can push acceptance) so we can align the timeline?
- Any additional stakeholders we should CC (SRE, security contact)?

I'll pull Priyom and Aditya into the technical details below.

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: rollback-checklist.md (md)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: MAP update — close date risk (technical notes)

Looping in the technical view so the MAP has concrete mitigations. Short summary: 

- Root cause: unusual tokenization edge-case in Helios's preprocessor that increases kv-cache churn; manifests at p95 latency under load.
- Hotfix (48–72 hours): enable model variant with stronger kv-cache affinity + transient prefix caching on the edge. This is reversible and compatible with the current contract model.
- Medium term (10 business days): deploy quantized variant with a focused eval of the failing prompt subset; we expect a small accuracy delta (0.5–1.8%) but large latency wins.

I added the rollback checklist to the MAP appendix with explicit commands, runbook steps, and a tagged owner per action. If Helios approves the 10-business-day acceptance extension, we can schedule the canary the day after the hotfix completes.

- Priyom
Prio Das
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@helios-sys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: MAP update — close date risk

Kimberly/Priyom — this reads well. Procurement requires a clear acceptance window and a signed acknowledgement of the rollback plan before we escalate to Legal. Two notes from our side:

- Acceptance window: Helios can extend to 12 business days if the final MAP includes the rollback checklist and a named SRE point of contact for the canary.
- SLA exception: we cannot change billing terms but can accept a temporary SLA exception for p95 latency if Redwood commits to the rollback triggers and a remediation timeline.

I'll confirm the SRE contact and get back this afternoon. Thanks for the speedy turnaround.

—Tom

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@helios-sys.com>, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated MAP + SLA exception request

Tom/Eleanor — attaching MAP_v2 with the rollback appendix expanded per Prio's runbook. Key changes: 
- Acceptance window: 12 business days (documented gate-by-gate).
- Rollback triggers: two independent metrics (p95 latency > 1.8x baseline for 10m OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m).
- Named POC: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.ai) as SRE canary lead; phone: +1 (415) 555-0146.
- SLA exception: added a temporary p95 latency exception clause to be approved by Legal; I included a draft PDF for Procurement review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Helios confirms SRE contact and signs the MAP acknowledgement (use the HubSpot link).
2) Redwood performs hotfix canary within 48–72 hours.
3) If canary passes, schedule full acceptance smoke test and start the 12-business-day window.

If Procurement signs off, we will not change pricing or contract language — just a short, documented deviation to the SLA for the remediation window.

Regards,
Kim
[Attachment: SLA_exception_request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@helios-sys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@helios-sys.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + SLA exception request

Thanks — looks actionable and narrowly scoped. Procurement will review the MAP and the SLA exception PDF; Tom will provide the SRE contact by EOD. Two confirmations from Helios: 
- We accept the 12-business-day window contingent on the canary schedule.
- Procurement wants the runbook excerpt to live in the shared Drive folder (the link you added looks fine).

Please consider this a provisional acceptance to proceed with the hotfix canary. We'll sign the MAP acknowledgement in HubSpot once Tom confirms the SRE POC.

Best,
Eleanor
